name: E2 fresh-room confirmation: frozen 30-seed policies in 16 never-used rooms with the source goal
written_before: the fresh geometry is generated and before any fresh-room policy outcome exists
authority: Author 2026-10-14: will not submit unless evidence is strong enough; reviewer weakness = all E2 follow-ups reuse the 16 exposed rooms
motivation: Every E2 result and follow-up used the same 16 rooms (data/audit/wacv_native_prior_confirmation_20261012/geometry_manifest.json). This is a confirmation on rooms no policy, analysis or design choice has touched.

geometry.generator_rules: identical to wacv_native_prior_confirm_env.generate: 18 blocked cells per room drawn uniformly from cells that are not native starts or the goal; every walkable cell connected to the goal; every native start within 30 steps of the goal
geometry.configuration_ids: 100-115 (8 pairs x A/B, ids only; no pairing used)
geometry.exclusion: reject any room whose blocked-cell set equals any of the 16 exposed rooms or an earlier fresh room

probe: identical to the E2 zero-shot probe: wacv_continual_factorial_claude.probe unchanged, clean tier, 30 trials per room (10 native starts x 3 textures), weights frozen; only the room cache is replaced
outcome: per seed: mean frozen successes /30 over the 16 fresh rooms

primary.family: Holm over 2, paired two-sided t over 30 seeds (exact/1e5 sign-flip reported)
primary.confirmation_criterion: E2 is confirmed on fresh rooms iff C1 and C2 both have positive mean and Holm-adjusted t p < .05

secondary.C4: species x choice interaction (human_bc - human_legal_uniform) - (rat_bc - rat_legal_uniform), t (exploratory in E2, registered here)
secondary.descriptive: all arm means; comparison with exposed-room E2 effect sizes is descriptive only

reporting: all outcomes reported whatever their direction; no design change after any fresh-room outcome; a failed confirmation will be reported in the paper
hardware: CPU only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty), as the original E2 probes
